title: Release of the Low-Temperature Cure Adhesive Bonding Process for Metallic Secondary Structure
abstract: Qualification and release of a low-temperature cure adhesive system for metallic secondary structure, so that bonded repairs and bonded straps can be cured without a heater blanket cycle that risks the surrounding protection scheme.

sections.reason: Bonded repairs and bonded straps on metallic secondary structure currently require a cure above one hundred and twenty degrees, which is delivered on wing with a heater blanket. Every operator survey since 2021 has named the blanket cycle as the least reliable part of a bonded repair: the thermal survey takes longer than the bond, the surrounding paint and sealant are damaged at the blanket edge, and on thin skin the process is at the limit of what can be controlled by a line team. Three operators have declined bonded repair schemes altogether for this reason and taken the weight of a bolted repair instead.
sections.description: The modification releases a two-part low-temperature cure adhesive system that reaches full strength at eighty degrees over sixteen hours, together with the surface preparation, the mixing control and the bond line thickness control that go with it. The process reference articles are the surface treatment washer D2040116882018 and the calibration bolt ZEDE604998-69, which are used to verify the preparation and the bond line before a repair is committed. Coupon and element level substantiation covers aluminium to aluminium and aluminium to titanium joints in secondary structure only; primary structure is explicitly excluded. The process, the equipment list and the acceptance criteria are on drawings D20401217009 and D20401293083.
sections.effects: No aircraft mass change and no electrical effect, because the modification releases a process rather than a part. Bonded repair cycle time on wing is expected to fall from three shifts to two, and the blanket edge damage that currently drives a paint rework disappears. The standard practices chapter, the bonded repair instructions in the structure repair manual and the consumables list all require re-issue. Repair schemes already published against the high temperature system remain valid and are not withdrawn.
sections.embodiment_note: There is no aircraft embodiment. The process is released to production and to the repair organisations once the certification review is closed; design is frozen and the substantiation package is with the authority. Operators will see it first as a new option in published repair schemes rather than as a bulletin.

type_data.balance_impact: None; the modification releases a process
type_data.production_impact: No line impact; released as an additional qualified process
